subject: Invoice 6213 — settlement sequence and remittance confirmation
messages:
--- Message 1 ---
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bridgepath.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: accounts-payable@bridgepath.com
Date: Tue, 1 May 2028 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice 6213 — payment sequencing request

Hi Aditya,

We received invoice INV-6213 for $128,450. BridgePath is prepared to remit, but AP has a cutoff on large ACH batches this month and expects card limits to be exhausted on 5/03. Would Redwood accept a split settlement? Proposed: $78,450 via ACH on 5/04 and $50,000 via wire on 5/09.

Also: can you confirm the bank account we should use for the wire and provide a remittance email once payment is sent? If you need a PO number on your end, PO# BP-9921 applies.

I attached our form W-9 and a remittance stub for internal routing.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Senior AP Manager
BridgePath Systems
Attachment: W9-BridgePath.pdf (application/pdf)

--- Message 2 ---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bridgepath.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 2 May 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice 6213 — payment sequencing request

Hi Samantha — appreciate the heads up. We can accommodate the split. Quick notes: 

- Confirmed amounts: $78,450 (ACH) on 2028-05-04, $50,000 (wire) on 2028-05-09.
- Wire details (Redwood Operating LLC):
  Bank: First Continental Bank
  ABA: 111000025
  Account: 046219823
  Reference: INV-6213 / PO BP-9921

We'll need a remittance email once each leg posts. For the ACH, please include the ACH trace number in the remittance. For the wire, can you confirm an expected value date? Our AP team marks the invoice as partially paid when the first leg clears.

Laura — tagging you to record the split and update the AR queue.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

--- Message 3 ---
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bridgepath.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: accounts-payable@bridgepath.com
Date: Thu, 3 May 2028 16:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice 6213 — payment sequencing request

Aditya — thanks for the quick confirm. A couple quick items: 

1) The ACH will be sent out on 5/04 with expected value date 5/04. We'll provide the ACH trace and a remittance email to payments@redwoodinference.com once it clears.
2) The wire will be booked on our side for value date 5/09. We do have a required beneficiary name check — is "Redwood Operating LLC" the legal beneficiary name that will match your bank files?
3) Our team has one remaining ask: please confirm whether Redwood needs VAT/tax documentation for BridgePath. We're US-based and don't charge VAT, but AP wants to attach any vendor tax proof needed for your finance records.

I'll push for both confirmations by EOD tomorrow.

Samantha
Attachment: payment_schedule_stub.txt (text/plain)

--- Message 4 ---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bridgepath.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice 6213 — payment sequencing request

Hi Samantha — all good, thanks. Confirmations below: 

- Beneficiary name: Redwood Operating LLC (exact match) — that will match bank beneficiary checks.
- VAT/tax docs: Not required for Redwood (US entity) for this vendor, but please keep the W-9 on file. We appreciate you attaching W9-BridgePath.pdf (received).
- Remittance routing: please send remittance notices to payments@redwoodinference.com and cc laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com. Include the payment method (ACH/wire), trace/reference number, and value date.

Once the ACH posts we'll mark INV-6213 as partially paid in our accounting system and send an updated statement. If the wire posts after cutoff we will reconcile against the remaining balance promptly.

If you hit any processing limits on your side and need us to accept a card for the second leg, we can route credit-card payment through our procurement portal, but that will add a 2.9% convenience fee unless BridgePath prefers to absorb it.

Thanks again — please send the ACH trace when available.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
